projects.adds: Meaningful revenue from FY29 at a guided 14–15% operating margin
projects.capacityAdd: +6,000 t a year, taking LT cable capacity to 7,200 t
projects.source: Q2 FY27 call and presentation (3 Nov 2026): trials targeted for Q4 FY28, meaningful revenue from FY29; Q4 FY26 call (25 May 2026); Crisil rationale (27 Apr 2026)

revisions.text: The 25 May 2026 call said the first phase would start gradually from FY27; on 3 Nov 2026 trials were targeted for Q4 FY28 because of long machinery delivery times

projects.name: 7 MW group-captive solar park
projects.what: A solar park under the open-access group-captive scheme to supply the group's plants; all hardware and equipment at site, but line laying and charging wait for regulatory approvals
projects.adds: Saves about ₹3–3.5 a unit of power; renewable share to rise to 35–40% in 3–4 years from about 20% (5.5 MW rooftop solar today)
projects.capacityAdd: About 7 MW of solar power for its own use
projects.source: Q2 FY27 call (3 Nov 2026): commissioning likely by January–February 2027; Q2 FY27 presentation; Q4 FY26 call and presentation (May 2026)

revisions.text: The May 2026 presentation targeted commissioning in H1 FY27 and the 25 May call Q3 FY27; on 3 Nov 2026 it was delayed by pending regulatory approvals to about January–February 2027
